meta.name: process:insurance_offer
meta.description: 231 (stage D, D-f3; the owner's decisions of 2026-10-26): a business property insurance quote as a process pack of shared capabilities only. A case processes the documents of its source (the quote request form, a property schedule per site, the claims history), turns what they hold into facts of the assessed units, asks the company register and the sanctions list, and a person checks and freezes the facts; the rules of the product version the case kept are evaluated, missing facts are asked for by a deadline, a person decides on the risk, the premium is computed from the tariff the case kept, and a person decides on the premium (above the limit another person than the risk's). The product, its rules, its tariff, the registers and the limit are invented (the trial); a live product and a live limit are the owner's decisions.

changelog.note: 231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of; its example material (the invented product set and the invented documents' packets)
231 (D-f9): the Overview opens with what holds the case, each with the view where it is resolved; the five work views are complete.
231 (D-f8): the covering letter (letter@1, a person accepts it; the offer's document attached) and its send into the output folder (send@1, a person starts it), on the Decision and release view.
231 (D-f7): the offer's Word document, printed from the accepted premium and stored with its version, on the Decision and release view.
231 (D-f6): the Decision and release view shows the two decisions (the risk, then the premium) with their choices and the second person.
231 (D-f5): the Calculation and versions view: the rules' evaluation, the missing facts and the premium, each with its versions; the cost moves to the Overview.
231 (D-f4): the Data check view: the field review of the check (the units, the disagreements to settle, the freeze), the facts read from the documents, and the two registers' answers.
231 (D-f3): the first version: from the documents to the premium decision; its work views come with stage D-f's elements.

title: Insurance quote
summary: A business property insurance quote: the request form, a property schedule per site and the claims history are read and checked, the product's rules applied, the premium worked out from its tariff, and the offer sent with a covering letter.
